title: ShinyHunters claims return after arrests, signs messages with old PGP keys
date_note: BleepingComputer (24 November) says the posts appeared on a new Tor leak site launched on 23 November.
summary: BleepingComputer reports that the ShinyHunters extortion group says it is back, in posts on a new Tor leak site launched on 23 November. BleepingComputer says it verified two messages signed with 2020 ShinyHunters keys, but they do not prove a return. The Register reports that Okta says a group called Inception is very likely ShinyHunters; Inception says it is a new group.
plain: The ShinyHunters extortion group says it has returned after arrests. Old digital signatures do not prove it. Okta says a group called Inception is very likely ShinyHunters; Inception denies it.
exec: An unproven claim that a data-extortion group is active again; Okta links a new group, Inception, to it, which Inception denies.

validation.note: BleepingComputer reports the group's claim and the signature caveat; The Register reports Okta's assessment of Inception and Inception's denial. Neither confirms identity.

review.note: Compared claim status, leak-site date, key rotation, 2020-key signatures and caveat with BleepingComputer
